title: Vacuum cleaning appliance
abstract: A vacuum cleaning appliance comprises a lower efficiency cyclone unit and a high efficiency cyclone unit connected in series. This enables both large and fine dirt particles to be dealt with.
gist: The invention combines two cyclone separators of different efficiencies in series. Larger dirt particles are removed in the first cylindrical cyclone, finer particles in a second frusto-conical cyclone, eliminating the need for dust bags and traditional filters.
